A0_A1.title: Emma
A0_A1.visualDescription: Bright early riser smiling with a cup of morning tea beside an open sunlit window.
A0_A1.anthem: 🎵 'Here Comes the Sun' by The Beatles

pages.bio: Hi! I am Emma. I wake up early at 6 AM every day. I drink hot green tea and open my windows to let in fresh morning air.
redFlags: ✗ Makes noise early in the morning

pages.bio: After breakfast, I walk in the green park for 30 minutes. I listen to birds sing and say hello to neighbor dogs.
Before I go to sleep, I read a simple book for 15 minutes. I turn off my phone and sleep very peacefully.

A0_A1.opener: Hello! Are you an early morning bird or a late night owl?
A0_A1.prompt: Describe Emma's morning routine, walking habits, and early sleep schedule.

A0_A1.title: Noah
A0_A1.visualDescription: Night owl working on a laptop with soft desk lamp lighting and music headphones.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Noah. I like the night! I stay awake until 1 AM reading or playing games. Quiet nights are peaceful for me.
I go to the gym at 8 PM after dinner. Lifting weights and running on the treadmill keeps me strong and healthy.
Every evening, I write my simple to-do list for tomorrow in a notebook. Organizing my day helps me stay calm.

A0_A1.opener: Hi! Do you prefer going to the gym in the morning or in the evening?
A0_A1.prompt: Talk about Noah's night owl habits, evening gym workout, and daily notebook planning.

A2.title: Chloe
A2.visualDescription: Serene yoga practitioner sitting on a mat doing morning stretching in a bright room with houseplants.

pages.bio: Hi, I'm Chloe! Every morning at 7 AM I do 20 minutes of yoga and gentle stretching on my mat. Starting the day with deep breathing keeps me calm and focused.
redFlags: ✗ Yoga mat takes up room space

pages.bio: For breakfast, I blend fresh spinach, banana, almond milk, and chia seeds. Eating healthy whole foods gives me lasting energy throughout my workday.
redFlags: ✗ Spends a lot on organic chia

pages.bio: Before sleeping, I write three things I am grateful for in my gratitude journal. Focusing on positive moments helps me sleep peacefully.

A2.opener: Bonjour! Do you practice daily morning stretching or do you prefer a hot cup of coffee first?
A2.prompt: Describe Chloe's morning yoga routine, healthy smoothie habits, and nightly journaling.

A2.title: Ethan
A2.visualDescription: Organized young professional checking a smartwatch while preparing a meal-prep container.

pages.bio: Hello! I'm Ethan, 26. I love structure and time management! I schedule my daily tasks using calendar apps and set reminders to stay organized.
On Sunday afternoons, I cook healthy meals for the entire work week. Storing portioned containers of chicken, rice, and vegetables saves time and money.
redFlags: ✗ Eats same lunch 5 days in a row

pages.bio: I turn off all phone notifications after 8 PM every evening. Spending two hours screen-free reading or walking helps me rest my mind.

A2.opener: Hi! Do you like organizing your week with meal prep or eating spontaneously?
A2.prompt: Write about Ethan's time management, weekly meal prep routine, and digital detox habits.

B1.title: Sora
B1.visualDescription: Minimalist carrying reusable cotton totes and glass jars at a zero-waste neighborhood bulk shop.

pages.bio: I'm Sora, 27. I practice a zero-waste lifestyle by shopping with reusable cloth bags and glass jars at bulk stores. Small daily choices collectively make a massive environmental impact.
I follow minimalist principles in my home environment. Owning fewer possessions reduces mental clutter and allows me to focus on meaningful experiences rather than material things.
I commute to work by bicycle year-round regardless of weather. Pedaling through urban streets keeps me physically fit while eliminating my transportation carbon footprint.

B1.opener: Hello! Have you ever attempted a zero-waste challenge or embraced minimalist living?
B1.prompt: Discuss Sora's commitment to zero-waste habits, minimalism, and eco-friendly commuting.

B1.title: Marcus
B1.visualDescription: Marathon runner lacing up running shoes at dawn on a misty riverfront track.

pages.bio: I'm Marcus, 29. I train for long-distance marathons by running 15 kilometers every morning at 5:30 AM. Developing physical endurance builds mental resilience for life's challenges.
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up at 5 AM every single day

pages.bio: I take a 2-minute ice-cold shower every morning after running. It boosts circulation, sharpens focus, and instantly dispels morning sluggishness.
redFlags: ✗ Tries to convince everyone to try cold showers

pages.bio: I log my daily water intake, sleep hours, and running mileage in a habit tracking app. Seeing unbroken consistency streaks motivates me to push further.

B1.opener: Hi! Do you thrive on strict disciplined routines or prefer a flexible, spontaneous day?
B1.prompt: Analyze Marcus's marathon training discipline, cold shower habit, and habit tracking.

B2.title: Valerie
B2.visualDescription: Focused executive practicing deep work techniques at a minimal wooden desk with an hourglass.

pages.bio: I'm Valerie, 30. As a strategy consultant, I structure my workday around uninterrupted 90-minute 'deep work' blocks, eliminating notifications to maximize cognitive output and flow state.
I optimize my circadian rhythm by getting direct sunlight exposure within 15 minutes of waking, delaying caffeine intake by two hours, and using dim red light spectrums before sleep.
Every evening I practice Stoic journaling, reflecting on what was within my control and mentally rehearsing potential challenges for the upcoming day to cultivate emotional tranquility.

B2.opener: Greetings! Do you design your daily habits around scientific biohacking or intuitive flexibility?
B2.prompt: Evaluate Valerie's deep work methodologies, circadian rhythm optimization, and Stoic philosophy.

B2.title: Gabriel
B2.visualDescription: Artistic polymath sketching ideas in a leather journal at a sunlit wooden table surrounded by plants.
B2.anthem: 🎵 'Rivers and Roads' by The Head and the Heart

pages.bio: I'm Gabriel, 32. I embrace a slow-living lifestyle that intentionally resists hyper-productivity culture, choosing instead to savor contemplative morning espresso rituals and artisanal craftsmanship.
Rather than rigid schedules, my routines adapt fluidly to seasonal cycles and creative moods—focusing on writing in autumn and outdoor woodworking during summer months.
redFlags: ✗ Hard to fix exact meeting times

pages.bio: My evenings involve candlelit dinners, vinyl listening sessions, and manual fountain pen journaling—fostering authentic tactile connections in an increasingly digitized society.

B2.opener: Hello! Do you lean toward optimizing daily efficiency or embracing the art of slow, seasonal living?
B2.prompt: Analyze Gabriel's slow living philosophy, polymorphic routines, and tactile evening rituals.
